remarks: Nestled on a sought-after South Wilton cul-de-sac, this stately Cornell Colonial offers an unbeatable location with seasonal reservoir views and proximity to town, top-rated schools, and prime commuting routes. This meticulously updated residence features four bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and a picturesque, private property with a flat backyard-perfect for outdoor enjoyment. Inside, the newly renovated eat-in kitchen boasts quartz countertops, all-new stainless steel appliances, and seamless flow into the dining room, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The elegant formal living room, anchored by a wood-burning fireplace, provides a welcoming space for gatherings, while the spacious family room with built-ins is perfect for movie nights. A cozy den, complete with a wood-burning stove and sliding doors leading to the patio and backyard, offers a warm and inviting retreat. A stylish powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, the private primary suite serves as a tranquil escape, featuring a dressing area and a newly renovated en-suite bath. Three additional bedrooms including a well-sized guest room, share a beautifully appointed hall bath. A large attic with pull-down stairs presents exciting expansion potential, while numerous major updates including a new roof, windows, siding, and furnace provide peace of mind for years to come. A full list of improvements is available in the addendum.
